data.one_liner: Unified and correct implementation of file saving across platforms.
data.what_it_does: UtopiaSaveFile provides a unified API to save files across Android, iOS, macOS, and Web. It handles MIME type inference, filename extensions, and triggers platform-native save dialogs or share sheets.
use_when: You need to let users save files or documents generated by your app across multiple platforms
You want a unified API that handles platform-specific save panels, system files apps, or share sheets
avoid_when: You only need local background file caching without user interaction
You are building a server-side Dart application
strengths: Provides a unified interface for saving files on Android, iOS, macOS, and Web
Automatically infers MIME types and handles extension matching
Requires no special storage permissions on Android or property list changes on iOS
weaknesses: Web downloads complete immediately via anchor elements even if the user cancels later
Platform behavior varies significantly (system files app on Android, share sheet on iOS, save panel on macOS)
data.setup_notes: No permissions needed on Android. No special Info.plist configuration is needed on iOS.
